# GORM 3.1.0-preview.1 — First public NuGet preview

GORM is an independent, MIT-licensed .NET 10 SQL Server Graph ORM.

This is the first publicly distributed preview. It establishes the independently maintained `Gorm` namespace, `GORM` NuGet package identity, package README, SourceLink symbols and a verified installation path. It is **not** a promise of stable API compatibility or a production support SLA.

## Included

- Strongly typed node and edge graph models; LINQ-style queries and graph traversal.
- Tracked graph persistence, relationships, transactional operations and history support.
- An in-memory execution option for testing and scenarios.
- Graph intelligence and experimental advanced capabilities already present in the source repository.

## Validation

- 1,188 MSTest unit tests passing in the first-release pipeline.
- Five real SQL Server 2022 Testcontainers integration tests: schema, persistence, edge traversal, rollback and history.
- CI NuGet package, symbols and standalone package-consumer validation.
- **Public NuGet installation** independently verified after indexing: [GitHub Actions run](https://github.com/pjotrcasteel/GORM/actions/runs/37825476545).

## Install

```bash
dotnet add package GORM --version 3.1.0-preview.1
```

[Package on NuGet.org](https://www.nuget.org/packages/GORM/3.1.0-preview.1) · [Documentation website](https://pjotrcasteel.github.io/GORM/) · [Release process](https://github.com/pjotrcasteel/GORM/blob/main/RELEASING.md)

The tag `v3.1.0-preview.1` is pinned to the **original source commit** `082c1b878fc9ab896d874f1940ccc45b58752b52`, from which the published package was built. Subsequent CI and documentation refinements are on `main`.
